content.text: yutz Share Facebook X WhatsApp Bluesky Edit Edit Pronunciations yutz (YUHTS) listen Record a Pronunciation Definitions n. A stupid jerk. Example Sentences "That guy is such a yutz." Record a Sentence Languages of Origin Yiddish Etymology probably from Yiddish יאָנץ yonts 'fool, numskull' Who Uses This Jews: Jews of diverse religious backgrounds and organizational involvements Regions North America Dictionaries None Alternative Spellings yuts Notes A combination of a yold (a fool) and a putz, i.e. a foolish putz.
